reason: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb (unsubscribe), a level above regular, meaning watching or tracking, is only lowered to regular; muting happens only on a later visit. Yet the page always shows 'You will stop receiving notifications for {{title}}' (config/locales/client.en.yml stop_notifications, rendered by templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs), and at the regular level Discourse still notifies on replies, mentions and quotes.
